Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BHU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Banaras Hindu University is 24-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Botany, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Plant Science, Plant Biotechnology, or a related field with at least 55% marks, along with a valid NET/GATE or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted, and then notified via email for an online or physical interview. The final selection will be based on the interview performance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Junior Research Fellow position at BHU must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of all educational certificates, mark sheets, caste certificates, score cards (NET/GATE), and previous research/work experience details.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent via email to the address specified in the official notification, which will be provided in the 'Important Links' section.
